title: Ordinary Freedom
logline: Three school friends spend one unremarkable field-trip day in Addis Ababa, and the narrator realises the ordinary days are the ones worth keeping.
audience: DRAFT — confirm in DESIGN.md: Ethiopian high-school students and recent graduates (16–22), watching on phones (9:16) in a social feed, often with sound off.
intent: DRAFT — confirm in DESIGN.md: leave viewers wanting to message their own school friends, and to notice that an uneventful day together is already a memory worth keeping.

shots.purpose: Establish place, time and season: cold morning on Entoto.
shots.reason: Opens on the feeling of the day (crisp air) before any plot.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot of a misty eucalyptus forest on the Entoto ridge at early morning, a group of high-school students in navy sweaters walking up a dirt path, sun rays through tall trees
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, mist drifting through the eucalyptus
shots.narration: The morning air at Entoto was cold enough to make us pull our sweaters tighter.

shots.reason: The film is about this trio; we meet them as a unit.
shots.image_prompt: three teenage schoolgirl friends standing together at a stone lookout point on a mountain ridge, catching their breath and smiling, morning light
shots.motion_prompt: slight handheld drift, hair moving in the wind
shots.narration: Meron, Selam and I stood at the lookout, still breathless from the steep climb up.

shots.purpose: Silent establishing view of Addis Ababa from above.
shots.reason: A breath without narration lets the city and music carry the moment.
shots.image_prompt: panoramic view from Entoto over Addis Ababa, a sea of terracotta and tin roofs in a soft morning haze, distant hills, no people
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan right across the city

shots.purpose: The photo that never works: humour and closeness.
shots.reason: Shows friendship through behaviour (laughing) instead of telling it.
shots.image_prompt: three teenage schoolgirls laughing hard while trying to take a selfie on a phone at a mountain lookout, wind blowing their hair, candid
shots.motion_prompt: gentle push-in, the girls burst out laughing
shots.narration: Meron insisted on a photo before the wind ruined our hair. Nobody could stand still.

shots.purpose: Shift of energy: quiet curiosity in the museum.
shots.reason: Contrast with the loud morning; music drops to a hush.
shots.image_prompt: three schoolgirls in navy sweaters leaning close to a glass display case in a quiet museum gallery, soft spotlights, whispering
shots.motion_prompt: slow lateral dolly along the glass cases
shots.narration: After lunch, the National Museum hushed us. We crowded the glass cases, whispering jokes.
